subject: Temporary no-PO path request for MicroVendor onboarding
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@microvendor.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: onboarding & invoice-only path for MicroVendor

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the intro last week — MicroVendor would love to get set up as a vendor with Redwood so we can start the two-week pilot integration. We're a small consultancy (sub-$10k work for the pilot) and our typical procurement asks clients for an invoice-only flow vs issuing a PO for every engagement.

Attached: MV-W9.pdf, MV-Liability-Cert.pdf

Can you confirm the documentation you need and whether MicroVendor can be approved on an "invoice-only" (no PO) basis for the pilot? If there are forms or an allowlist we should be on, happy to complete them today.

Best,
Aisha Patel
COO, MicroVendor Co.
ProcureOps: procureops@microvendor.co

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@microvendor.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & invoice-only path for MicroVendor

Hi Aisha — cc'ing Marissa (procurement) to kick off intake.

Short answer: we have an invoice-only path for small vendors but it requires a short exception approval and a few items up front. Marissa — can you confirm the checklist and whether this fits the current pilot thresholds?

Aisha, to speed things up please share the SOW (or a one-page statement of work) and confirm expected pilot total (estimate). Our typical checklist for invoice-only like this is:
- W9 (received)
- Liability insurance cert (received)
- SOW or invoice estimate
- Bank/accounting details (for ACH)
- Point of contact for billing

If approved, procurement will add MicroVendor to the temporary allowlist and waive PO creation for the pilot period.

Also linking our vendor intake form: https://redwood.app/vendor-intake (please fill if you haven't).

I'll monitor and follow up — want to avoid payment hold-ups so engineering can start the integration.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha@microvendor.co>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & invoice-only path for MicroVendor

Morning all — thanks for the heads-up, Jordan. Reviewing MicroVendor's docs now. Attaching our internal quick-reference (approval-guidelines.pdf) but summarizing below: 

Eligibility for invoice-only (no PO) path — pilot exceptions:
- Pilot total must be <= $15,000 over 90 days
- First two invoices must be <= $5,000 each (we can waive PO for these)
- Vendor must provide W9 + COI (certificate of insurance) naming Redwood as certificate holder
- Vendor must be registered in our accounting system with ACH details and a primary billing contact
- Procurement requires a signed SOW or an invoice estimate and a short risk attestation (one-paragraph)

Additional controls: finance will place MicroVendor on a 90-day temporary allowlist; after that, we review for standard PO flow. We also do a quick Sanctions/PEP check.

Aisha — please upload the SOW (or share DocuSign link) and confirm the pilot invoice cadence. If everything matches the checklist, I'll issue the exception approval by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: approval-guidelines.pdf

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

>
> Pilot estimate: $9,500 total; first invoice planned at $4,750 (mid-September), second invoice at $4,750 (end of September).

Hi Aisha — good morning. I've reviewed the checklist and confirmed the W9 + COI + SOW are on file. Finance approves a conditional invoice-only (no-PO) path for the MicroVendor pilot with the following terms: 

- Approval valid for 90 days from 2027-08-18.
- PO waived for the first two invoices up to $5,000 each. Any invoice over $5,000 requires a PO and pre-approval.
- Vendor will be added to temporary allowlist ID: MV-TEMP-2027-08 (expires automatically after 90 days).
- MicroVendor must submit invoices with the purchase-code "MV-PILOT-2027" and our AP team will route for payment within standard terms (Net 30).
- This exception is conditional on completion of the sanctions screen and a verification call (scheduled by procurement) — please expect an invite.

Next steps for Aisha/Samir:
1) Confirm DocuSign is complete.
2) Confirm bank/ACH upload in the intake form (screenshot accepted).
3) Join verification call (procurement will schedule).

I'll mark this as approved in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/34567 (record: allowlist note added). Once the allowlist is active, you can submit the first invoice per the instructions above.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance (acting)
Redwood Inference
